title: EM9305 NVM program/erase: HCI 0xFD06 first, plus 0xFD03/0xFD04
scope: Emulator-only NVM model in ~/Repo/g2-firmware-emulator (no commit). No hardware flash. DFU completion and case-reply disarm are not in this step.
evidence_sources: EMSMM_NVMEraseMain.c / WriteAtAddress.c / WriteContinue.c: magic CM, status 0/0x12/0x2f/0x0c

model.FD06_NVMEraseMain: CM required; plen 0; clears memoryFixtures below 0x00F00000 (keeps RF 0x00F0xxxx); NvmMainErased=true
model.FD07_NVMErasePage: CM + LE32 address; clears 4 KiB window (not a measured page size)
model.FD03_WriteAtAddress: CM + plen>=5; writes payload into memoryFixtures; sets write cursor
model.FD04_WriteContinue: CM + pending cursor; appends at cursor
model.FD01: unchanged fixture read path (boot trim/version before CM)
model.prepare_fixtures: 0x00F0040C and 0x00F0041C synthetic zeros added to controller-peripherals.resc

fc4e.status: still unmodeled — next gap for a completed DFU check

firmware_verification.note: Erase and program path ran. Two FD06 successes, then a large FD03 write stream. DFU is not complete: 0xFC4E CRC is unmodeled so update_check cannot succeed. Advertising still came up on the mismatched controller.

next: Model HCI 0xFC4E CRC32 (and any remaining recover/finalize), re-run the mismatch pair through a completed DFU, then (3) case-reply disarm with a pogo product-test frame.
